Mod.Name: Memoria Dev Console
Mod.Author: Cheddarbung
Mod.Description:
MEMORIA DEV CONSOLE 1.4.1 ========================
Fixed black backgrounds in the Rendered Field Viewer. MDC detects each field atlas and uses 32 px tiles for original backgrounds or 64 px tiles for Moguri overrides, even when the global tile setting differs. The viewer also skips the invalid placeholder field when opening.
An All-in-One Development Toolkit for Final Fantasy IX Memoria Dev Console (MDC) brings essential Final Fantasy IX modding tools together in one workspace. From debugging and testing to field artwork editing and custom world-map entrances, MDC is designed to make developing and experimenting with FFIX mods faster and easier.
Press F10 to show or hide MDC. Use arrows and Enter, or the home-menu shortcuts. Development pages pause normal gameplay; Live Log lets the game keep running.
RUNTIME CONTROLS --------------- [L] LIVE LOG - Follow Memoria.log while playing, including startup, warnings, and errors. - Press F to show, hide, or highlight installed-mod and Memoria log entries. Identification uses available tags; ambiguous lines stay under Unattributed.
[1] COMPILE + RESTART - Run Memoria's existing compiler and read its output inside MDC. - Restart FFIX after a successful build; stay in MDC to fix and retry failures. - Build runtime sources installed by the World Entrance Editor.
[2] RESTART GAME / [3] RETURN TO LAUNCHER - Restart directly to reload scripts, patches, and game data. - Return to the launcher when changing enabled mods, load order, or settings.
[4] SAVE STATES - Browse recent field history, set a checkpoint, or create named snapshots. - Named snapshots support fields and world maps, with screenshots and party previews. Development snapshots are separate from normal game saves. - Capture and restore music alongside snapshot state.
NAVIGATION ---------- [5] WARP / STORY JUMP - EXPERIMENTAL - Jump to development checkpoints or enter a mapped Field ID and story counter. - Recreate testing conditions quickly; keep a normal save before testing warps.
INSPECTION AND CREATION ---------------------- [M] MODEL VIEWER - Inspect models, animations, weapons, textures, bones, and SPS effects. - Open from fields, world maps, or battles; restore the game when leaving. - Export the selected model with F11. Search SPS effects with F3. - Field scenes return through their latest stable entrance snapshot.
[S] SFX PREVIEWER - Preview native effects with selectable enemy targets and battle arenas. - Search the full SFX list; play, pause, replay, stop and preview hit reactions. - Includes optional sound playback, preview damage and hover help.
[F] RENDERED FIELD VIEWER - Browse fields by ID/name with backgrounds, SPS, tile animation and audio. - Separate background/object effects, global audio mute and loop controls. - All-scenario mode overlaps reference effects; placement is approximate.
[6] FIELD BACKGROUND TOOLKIT - Export a source field by ID or export the current loaded field. - Collect BGX/layer PNGs and available background, walkmesh, atlas, and SPS resources, with an export report. - Build a composite preview, redesign the artwork, then rebuild a native field atlas. - Automatically fit a redesigned PNG to the required canvas resolution. - Preserve BGS tile depths, geometry, alpha masks, and effect textures. - Install NativeField contents; keep PNG/BGX references in EditingReferences. - Reuse the selected field, inspect PNG dimensions, and open output folders. - Composite previews approximate layering; check animation, depth, and walkmesh alignment in game. Resizing fits the canvas and can stretch the artwork.
[9] SOUND BROWSER - Browse sound effects, music, songs, movie audio, and SFX sound banks. - Viewer-style searchable lists, white sound labels, theme-colored selection and hover help. - Preview with Enter; filter entries and inspect known uses and categories. - Stop or replace previews without leaving an earlier load playing later. - Press Ctrl+C to copy the selected sound's PlaySound call for a custom SEQ.
[7] WORLD ENTRANCE CREATOR - Capture an on-foot world position and create a custom field entrance. - Configure destination, arrival entrance, activation radius, and nameplate. - Set world-state, story-progress, and mod-defined condition restrictions. - Read a definition for each highlighted setting; F1 opens all controls. - Test immediately through MDC, without compiling or installing a mod. - Install entrance JSON and generated runtime sources into a selected mod, then use Compile + Restart when the runtime needs rebuilding. - Current compiled runtimes can reload JSON-only entrance changes. - Exported entrances work for players without MDC installed. - Support a return to the recorded world entrance through a field-script MemoriaDictionary 988 flag. The destination script controls arrival placement. - Advanced Dead Pepper Gate can require native Choco pepper use to unlock an entrance permanently in that save. This feature remains experimental. - Installation backs up only replaced source/data files and rolls back partial writes. It does not build or replace a mod DLL. Complete mod sources are required before compiling; DLL-only targets without sources are rejected.
[8] BATTLE SCENE EDITOR - Inspect and edit battle-scene setup through MDC.
[0] ASSET DUMPER - Dump a model as FBX by ID using the same rotation/export logic as Model Viewer. - Export model textures by model ID or across the known model list. - Export the current battle background's textures and material map. - Dump battle script bytes and native SFX reference data. - Export world-map 2D texture atlases and animation frames with an index/report. - Field export, compositing, and cutting live in Field Background Toolkit.
[C] CONSOLE COLOR - Choose a saved accent color for headers and selection highlights. White is default. - Description emphasis stays cyan, or gold with the cyan theme.
WORKFLOW AND FILES ------------------ - Readable grouped menus, contextual help, wrapped text, and content-sized windows. MDC ignores typing in other applications. - Generated asset exports go under Memoria Dev Console\Asset Dump. - Required portrait, sound identity, and entrance-editor resources live under Memoria Dev Console\FF9_Data. Keep these folders when sharing MDC. - MDC test entrance JSON lives in FF9_Data\EntranceEditor\Tests. - Installed entrances live in the target mod's FF9_Data\CustomWorldMapEntrances. - Restart FFIX after updating MDC or compiling a changed runtime.
Built for field and battle scripting, C# development, artwork replacement, audio identification, compatibility work, and repeated encounter testing.
